description: This file contains a Perl module 'Git::Packet' that defines functions for reading, writing, and processing Git protocol packets, including binary and text packet handling, capability management, and initialization routines.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists for equality, returns true if they match exactly.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning status and content.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes a trailing LF from a buffer or dies if not present.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, returning status and buffer content.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key-value text packet expecting a specific key, dies on inconsistency.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes any pending packet data by writing a zero-length packet.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Initializes a packet exchange with handshake, verifying and sending version info.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the remote end.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities and verifies that all required ones are present.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Checks advertised remote capabilities against our capabilities and writes supported ones.
